seoTitle: How to View Your Purchase History on eBay
metaDescription: Learn how to find and filter your past eBay orders in the My eBay Purchase History tab on both the website and mobile app.
intro: If you've ever needed to track a shipment, request a return, or reorder something you bought months ago, digging through eBay's menus for your past orders can feel like more work than it should be. Purchase History is the one place that holds every order you've placed, with filters for date, status, and item type so you're not scrolling endlessly. This guide walks through exactly where that page lives in the eBay menu structure, what you can do once you're there, and what to check if an order seems to be missing.

steps.heading: Open the My eBay menu
steps.body: From any page on eBay while signed in, hover over "My eBay" in the top-right corner of the navigation bar. A dropdown appears with your account activity split into sections — Summary, Recently Viewed, Bids/Offers, Watchlist, and further down, Purchase History alongside Buy Again and Selling. This menu is the fastest route to your order data because eBay doesn't surface a persistent "Orders" tab the way some other marketplaces do; it's tucked inside this hover menu instead.

image.caption: The My eBay dropdown, with Purchase History listed between Watchlist and Buy Again. This is the quickest way into your order records from any page.

steps.heading: Click into Purchase History
steps.body: Selecting Purchase History from the dropdown takes you to a chronological list of everything you've bought, most recent first. Each entry shows the item, seller, price paid, and current order status, so you can tell at a glance whether something has shipped, delivered, or is still pending. This same section also appears in the left-hand sidebar when you're browsing other parts of your account overview, listed under "Buying" alongside Bids/Offers and eBay Bucks — useful to know if you land on a different account page first and need a second way in.

image.caption: The account sidebar under Buying, where Purchase History sits alongside Bids/Offers and eBay Bucks as an alternate way to reach your order list.

steps.heading: Filter orders by date, status, or item type
steps.body: Once you're in the Purchase History list, use the filter controls above the order list to narrow things down. You can restrict the view to a specific date range, filter by order status such as shipped or delivered, or search by keyword if you remember the item name but not when you bought it. This matters most once your history stretches back years, since scrolling through hundreds of orders to find one purchase from last spring wastes far more time than a two-click filter.

steps.heading: Track shipments and manage returns from the same view
steps.body: Each order row links out to the details you actually need day to day: tracking numbers for anything in transit, an option to print or download an invoice, and a direct path to request a return or refund if the item didn't work out. Because these actions live right next to the order itself, you don't have to jump between a separate tracking page and a separate returns center — it's the reason Purchase History is worth checking before contacting a seller directly with a shipping question.

steps.heading: Check archived or hidden purchases if something's missing
steps.body: Occasionally an order you're sure you placed won't show up in the default list. eBay lets you hide individual purchases from your main view, and very old orders can end up archived depending on your account settings. Look for an "archived" or "hidden" toggle near the top of the Purchase History page before assuming the order vanished — it almost never actually disappears, it's just filtered out of the default display.

steps.heading: Do the same from the mobile app
steps.body: The eBay app mirrors this structure closely: tap the My eBay icon, then Purchase History, and you'll see the same filterable list with the same shipping, return, and invoice actions. This is handy if a package shows up at your door and you want to confirm the order details on the spot rather than waiting until you're back at a desktop.

faq.question: Where do I find my purchase history on eBay?
faq.answer: Hover over My eBay in the top navigation bar and select Purchase History from the dropdown, or find it in the Buying section of your account sidebar.

faq.question: Can I filter my past orders?
faq.answer: Yes, you can filter purchase history by date, order status, or item type to find what you're looking for faster.

faq.question: What if a purchase doesn't show up in my history?
faq.answer: Check the archived or hidden purchases section, since older or manually hidden orders may not appear in the default view.

faq.question: Can I download receipts from my purchase history?
faq.answer: Yes, you can print or download invoices for past orders directly from your purchase history.

faq.question: Does purchase history work the same on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, the eBay app has the same Purchase History section with the same filtering, tracking, and return options as the desktop site.
